quizName: Hardest Questions in Connecticut Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT protect a motorcycle rider?

options.text: A baseball cap that fits snugly

questions.correctAnswerText: A baseball cap that fits snugly
questions.explanation: Wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, high boots or shoes that support your ankles, and durable gloves.

questions.question: When should you use a turn signal?

options.text: When you plan to speed up

questions.explanation: Use your turn signal every time you turn or change lanes, even if you think no one is watching.

questions.question: A friend has drunk too much and wants to ride their motorcycle. What should you do?

options.text: Tell them to use quiet roads

questions.explanation: Never allow someone to ride if they have been drinking. Do what you can to stop them, including taking their keys. Help them find another way home.

questions.question: What protection do goggles provide?

options.text: The same protection as a face shield
The same protection as a windshield

questions.explanation: Goggles protect your eyes but not your face. A face shield protects your whole face and is better than goggles. A windshield does not replace a face shield or goggles.

questions.question: Which of these is a slippery surface for a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Wet pavement, loose gravel or sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal covers are slippery. Ride carefully on these surfaces.

questions.question: You feel tired while riding. What should you do?

options.text: Keep riding and hope you wake up

questions.explanation: Do not ride when you are tired. On long trips, take a rest break at least every two hours to avoid fatigue.

questions.question: How can you reduce the chance of an accident?

options.text: Blend in with traffic so drivers do not notice you
Skip turn signals except at night
Use turn signals when changing lanes or turning
Ride very close to the vehicle ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Use turn signals when changing lanes or turning
questions.explanation: Be visible to other drivers. Use turn signals, brake lights, and proper lane position. Keep distance between you and other vehicles. Look ahead 12 seconds and be ready for hazards.

questions.question: Where should you get information about your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Use your owner's manual for information about your specific motorcycle. It has details about how to operate it and how to maintain it.

questions.question: What is the best source of information for your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Read your owner's manual before riding your motorcycle for the first time. This is especially important if you are riding a borrowed motorcycle.

questions.question: How can you help others see you while riding?
questions.explanation: Be more visible by wearing bright colors, keeping your headlight on at all times, and using your turn signals.

questions.question: What types of brakes do most motorcycles have?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycles have one brake for each wheel. The front brake is stronger than the rear brake.

questions.question: Which of these does not need regular checking?
questions.explanation: Before each ride, check your tires, controls, chain, sprockets, shock absorbers, fasteners, and brakes. Small mechanical problems on a motorcycle can be very dangerous.

questions.question: The most important thing you can do to survive a crash is to:

options.text: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a good helmet that is fastened securely.
questions.explanation: Wearing a good helmet that is fastened securely is the most effective way to improve your chances of surviving a crash.

questions.question: Why are turn signals important on a motorcycle?

options.text: They serve little purpose since motorcycles are smaller than most other vehicles.
They alert other drivers to what you plan to do.
You should not use them if no vehicles are nearby.
They are more complicated than those on a car.

questions.correctAnswerText: They alert other drivers to what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: As a motorcycle rider, you are more vulnerable. Always use your turn signals to warn others of your plans. Use them whenever you change lanes or turn, even if you think no one is nearby.

questions.question: Which of these is not protective clothing for a motorcyclist?
questions.explanation: Wear protective clothing when riding. This includes sturdy pants and jackets that cover your arms and legs, boots or heavy shoes that protect your ankles, and sturdy gloves.

questions.question: How can your body get rid of alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time allows your body to remove alcohol. There are no shortcuts to becoming sober.
